answer: Require each new identity to complete a paid onboarding voyage: a chain of small real jobs, each checked by a different established client, before it earns full trading rights. A hollow shell with no work history stays throttled near zero, while every verified job adds lasting pigment to its reputation record, a stain that cannot be faked or transferred. Forging 1,000 identities means funding 1,000 separate voyages of real work, so sybil farming costs more than it earns.
